content: नियमः .²1 Restraining, checking. .²2 Taming, subduing. .²3 Confining, preventing. .²4 A restraint, check; वाचि नियमः <ls>U. 2. 2</ls>; अधर्मानियमः <ls>Ms. 8. 122</ls>. .²5 Restriction, limitation; <ls>Mb. 14. 13. 11</ls>. .²6 A rule or precept, law (in general), usage; नायमेकान्ततो नियमः <ls>Ś. B.</ls> .²7 Regularity; कुसुमसुकुमारमूर्तिर्दधती नियमेन तनुतरं मध्यम् <ls>Ratn. 1. 20</ls>. .²8 Certainty, ascertainment. .²9 An agreement, promise, vow, engagement. .²10 Necessity, obligation. .²11 Any voluntary or self-imposed religious observance (dependent on external conditions); [The earliest explanation of this expression is the one found in the <ls>ŚB. on MS. 4. 2. 24</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> कोऽयं नियमः . अनियतस्य नियतता . प्रयोगाङ्गतया सर्वे देशाः प्राप्नुवन्ति, न तु समच्चयेन . यदा समो न तदा विषमः . यदा विषमो न तदा समः . स एष समः प्राप्तश्चाप्राप्तश्च . यदा न प्राप्तः स पक्षो विधिं प्रयोजयति. This is very nicely stated in the Vārttika--‘नियमः पाक्षिके सति’]; <ls>R. 1. 94</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 40</ls>; (see <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Śi. 13. 23</ls>). .²12 Any minor observance or lesser vow, a duty prescribed to be done, but which is not so obligatory as a यम <ab>q. v.</ab> शौचमिज्या तपो दानं स्वाध्यायोपस्थनिग्रहः . व्रतमौनोपवासं च स्नानं च नियमा दश .. Atri. .²13 Penance, devotion, religious austerities; नियमविध्नकारिणी <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; <ls>R. 15. 74</ls>. .²14 (In <ab>Mīm. phil.</ab>) A rule or precept which lays down or {%specifies%} something which, in the absence of that rule, would be {%optional%}; विधिरत्यन्तमप्राप्तौ नियमः पाक्षिके सति. .²15 (In Yoga <ab>phil.</ab>) Restraint of the mind, the second of the 8 principal steps of meditation in {%Yoga%}; दशैते नियमाः प्रोक्ता योगशास्त्रविशारदैः <ls>Tantrasāra.</ls> .²16 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) A poetical common place or convention, as the description of the cuckoo in spring, peacocks in the rains <ab>&c.</ab> .²17 Defining, definition. .²18 Keeping down, lowering (as the voice). .²19 Keeping secret; मन्त्रस्य नियमं कुर्याः <ls>Mb. 5. 141. 20</ls>. .²20 Effort (यत्न); यथैते नियमं पौराः कुर्वन्त्यस्मिन्निवर्तने <ls>Mb. 2. 46. 20</ls>. (नियमेन as a rule, invariably).
